caption: The design is locked to process 'SOI 220' via ONE shared PlacementPolicyContext that manual placement, paste, and the AI assistant all consult.
A component from member PDK 'Demo' passes the shared context's CheckPlacement and lands on the canvas.
Placing a component from foreign PDK 'HHI-InP' is rejected by the same shared context and the block reason appears in the status line.
A process-agnostic tool PDK ('Analysis Tools') stays placeable because the shared context carries the agnostic-PDK list for every consumer.
Pasting clipboard content from a foreign PDK is blocked, naming the active process read live from the shared context (PlacementContext.ActiveProcess).
